h:
这是我正在使用的基本 MiniMax H3 工作流程。我喜欢把事情整理得井井有条，所以我为自己做了这个，也不妨分享一下。

选择模式将发送信号自动调整路径，因此节省空间且无冗余。

节点仅限于每个组，以 GET 和 SET 作为起点和终点，因此您可以放心地根据自己的喜好移动组。

我使用 H3 Prompt Writer，因此工作流程本身不包含自动提示。

使用方法：

T2V - 选择 FL2V 模式时禁用第一帧和最后一帧，自动从分辨率选择器获取尺寸

FL2V - 选择 FL2V 模式时启用第一帧（和最后一帧），自动从图像调整大小中获取尺寸

REF2V - 选择 REF2V

对于优化节点，使用 Ctrl+B 启用它们。如果您想快速访问它们，请告诉我。

将 Spectrum 和 FirstBlockCache 放在一起可能是一个错误。仅启用其中之一。

所有自定义节点链接都包含在 Markdown 注释中。如果找不到，请使用旧版 UI 并通过 Git URL 安装。

o.en:
This is the basic MiniMax H3 workflow I am using. I like keeping things organized so I made this for myself and might as well share it.

Choosing mode will send the signal to adjust pathways automatically, so it is space efficient and no redundancy.

Nodes are confined to each group, with GET and SET as start and end points, so you can move groups around to your liking without worry.

I use H3 Prompt Writer so auto prompting is not included in the workflow itself.

How to use:

T2V - Disable both First and Last Frame while choosing FL2V Mode, automatically takes dimensions from Resolution Selector

FL2V - Enable First Frame (and Last Frame) while choosing FL2V Mode, automatically takes dimensions from Image Resize

REF2V - Choose REF2V

For the optimization nodes, enable them with Ctrl+B. Let me know if you want quick access for them.

Putting Spectrum and FirstBlockCache together might be a mistake. Only enable one of them.

All custom nodes links are included in markdown note. Use legacy UI and install via Git URL if you can't find it.
